title: Best Hotel Day Passes in Marrakech 2026 — Pools, Spas and Lunches, Ranked
image_query: infinity pool luxury hotel atlas mountains
body:
Best overall: Mandarin Oriental — Villa for a Day from 2,800 MAD (2 guests). Private pool, butler, gourmet lunch. Book 48h ahead.

Best value luxury: Park Hyatt Marrakech — Pool and lunch from 700 MAD/person. Atlas Mountain views. Tue-Fri only.

Best for groups: Fairmont Royal Palm — from 950 MAD, summer deals available.

Best for families: Es Saadi — Waterpark + pool + Sunday lunch from 550 MAD/adult.

No car needed: Sofitel Marrakech — central Hivernage, pool from 500 MAD.

Source: MadeInCity Marrakech, visited July 2026.
